benchmark_methodology: Rigorous varying temperature T = 300 + (i % 1000)*0.5 K with volatile checksum accumulation on both C++ and Python.

historical_invalidated_timings.invalidation_reason: Native benchmark previously invoked setTemperature(T) without requesting polynomial property outputs, measuring only cache tag update rather than 53-species polynomial evaluations.

notes: Pure Python polynomial evaluation is 69.7x native speed for scalar and 217.5x for batch 53-species update.
